svg.text: Blog · My first week at a new school
Last Monday I started at a new school in Lviv, and I was terrified. My family moved
here in August because of my dad's job, so I did not know anyone.
In the first lesson the teacher asked me to introduce myself. My voice was shaking,
and I forgot half of what I wanted to say. Luckily, a girl called Marta smiled at me
and later invited me to sit with her at lunch.
By Wednesday I had met most of my classmates. They are friendly, although some of them
speak so fast that I can hardly understand them! What I like most is the school choir.
I joined it on Thursday, and the conductor says I have a strong voice.
